ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the above food web diagram, which species supplies energy?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In this food web diagram, Grass plants, Grasshopper, Rabbit, Praying mantis, Sparrow, Fox, and Hawk are labeled. Grass plants are located at the bottom of the diagram, and there are arrows from Grass plants pointing to Grasshopper and Rabbit. Other arrows continue from these animals to higher-level consumers. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate that energy flows from the food source being eaten to the organism that eats it. Because Grass plants are producers at the bottom, and arrows point from them to animals, the ones that supply energy are plants.
